title: Save on LED Masks and More With CurrentBody’s Black Friday Deals
gist: Promotional Black Friday deal post: beauty-tech brand CurrentBody discounts most products 20% through December 8, including the LED Face Mask Series 3 ($456) and LED Hair Growth Helmet ($688). Thin signal beyond pricing and product specs.

insights.claim: CurrentBody's Black Friday sale runs until December 8 with most products, including bundles, 20% off.
insights.speaker: Boutayna Chokrane
insights.so_what: Broad 20% discounting on premium beauty-tech signals holiday price promotion as a demand lever in the category.
insights.locator: Beauty tech titan CurrentBody's Black Friday deals are live

insights.claim: The reviewer advises almost always waiting for a sale to buy CurrentBody gadgets because they are expensive.
insights.speaker: Boutayna Chokrane
insights.so_what: Premium at-home beauty devices appear price-sensitive, with demand concentrated around promotions.

insights.claim: CurrentBody's LED Face Mask Series 3 adds blue, green and yellow wavelengths, raises LED count from 236 to 750 and irradiance to 40 mW/cm², and is discounted from $570 to $456.
insights.speaker: Boutayna Chokrane
insights.so_what: Spec escalation in at-home LED masks shows competition on features in the beauty-tech category.

insights.claim: CurrentBody's LED Hair Growth Helmet, discounted from $860 to $688, produced visible hair-growth results for a WIRED reviewer and her roommate after 12 weeks of 10-minute daily use.
insights.speaker: Boutayna Chokrane
insights.so_what: Anecdotal efficacy only; at-home hair-loss devices are a premium consumer-health niche.
insights.locator: The Best Hair Loss Treatment Is $688
